references.text: Psalm 62:10 speaks of not trusting in wealth or becoming proud of accumulated riches, which mirrors the dilemma of the rich young man in Mark 10:22.
Isaiah 55:1-3 encourages seeking the Lord and listening to Him, which can be seen in contrast to the rich young man's choice to walk away from Jesus because of his wealth.
Matthew 19:21-22 gives a parallel account where Jesus tells the rich young man to sell what he owns and give to the poor, along with his sorrowful reaction.
Luke 18:22-23 also provides a parallel account to Mark 10:22, where the rich young man becomes sad when Jesus tells him to sell all that he has.
